description.value: The Pie Hole is a beloved BC pie bakery founded by Jenell Parsons in 2011, growing from farmer's markets and food truck festivals to three brick-and-mortar locations, including this Langley outpost on Fraser Highway. The shop offers an extensive rotating menu of both sweet and savoury pies — from Vietnamese Coffee and Fat Elvis to Thai Chicken and Steak & Stout — alongside vegan and gluten-free options. Founder Jenell Parsons is widely celebrated as 'Canada's Pie Queen' and has been featured on Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 25m; stands (4 spaces) at 40m; bollard (2 spaces) at 100m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Pie Hole at 20534 Fraser Hwy, Langley is an active brick-and-mortar location (one of three), and the contact page provides a phone number (604-510-7437) absent from OSM. The menu pages explicitly list vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free pie options, and the contact page confirms walk-in pickup/takeout. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible bakery/cafe with confirmed Langley location. The wide savoury pie selection makes it a practical meal stop for touring cyclists on Fraser Highway.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegan pies (Vegan Strawberry Rhubarb, Vegan Apple, Vegan Moroccan Chickpea, Vegan Mushroom Bourguignon, Vegan Holiday Pie), vegetarian options (Spinach & Feta), and at least one GF item (Chocolate Hazelnut Cream Pie labelled GF/V)
